desktop.notes:
• Album counts show the whole Library: each album reads (from this folder, dimmed) and its total in the Library - e.g. Tanzania (0) 97 - so an album whose photos came from Curish / Wildframe no longer looks empty. Hover for which is which.
• Adding a discarded photo to an album makes it a Keep (you want it, after all). Undecided photos stay undecided; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
• Albums stay in step with the Library by themselves: album changes send their photos + .pnfo in the background, and changes made in Curish / Wallpaper Studio show up here within seconds (Settings: Keep albums in step with the Library).
• Drag an album to reorder the list - the order is shared with Curish.
